title: Add a source-bound six-plane pricing oracle with funded-candidate checks (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Add `research/source-bound-price-oracle`, a reusable pure Python standard-library six-plane evidence compatibility oracle, schema, fixed reviewer policies and source-bound receipt consumers. Its actual frozen [PR #5383](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5383) and [PR #5387](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5387) joins return FUNDED_CONDITIONAL at `151333/50000000` and `605334953/200000000000`, respectively. These are compatibility conclusions consuming independently certified, hash-bound physical/census/closure/funding receipts. This PR supplies no new construction, κ mechanism, root engine, cold replay, global optimum, hosted validation or selected transition.

Unknown costs remain explicit and block funding. Equal histograms transfer no physical or precision coverage; [PR #5387](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5387) uses its own fresh physical receipt and complete invoice. Five inherited framework assumptions remain. SHA256 binds bytes against the separately trusted policy; it does not machine-prove arbitrary prose. Publication and selected labels require separate evidence. The source-certified compiler domain is the single literal power 1024/cutoff20/floor21/tail1/5/theta63/64/logpower1000 tuple and the individual exact receipt points.

## Task and overlap

Assigned reusable oracle/library publication, refining pinned `independent-moment` at canonical base `1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4`. Coordination claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5387#issuecomment-6374985927 . Scientific source heads are [PR #5383](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5383) `4bd6efa51a495a7c7b7754915cf0244e7e60969e` and [PR #5387](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5387) `b1ab650d36f59e5be682a813145b7c67e219e341`. This reusable compatibility package complements the separate independent-validation package without duplicating its scientific engines. [PR #5384](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5384) is verification of [PR #5377](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5377), not an additional construction or additive κ gain.

All necessary frozen bytes are committed package-local. `frozen/MANIFEST.json` retains the original 93-file review draft, manifest SHA256 `3dd8af4470220929ee516f2d3a97eba6db45ff55908c2cb5ca441f75459fdbed`; the manifest itself is additional. Historical draft wording and source notices remain intact. The root calibration adapter is read-only and keeps its predicates active under optimized Python. Pending source heads are informational identities, with their retained bytes covered offline; replay does not depend on foreign Git objects.

## Validation

Publication commit: `96f193143a7a2ff8a4e6b9d574d7f551d68a7da3` (108 new package files, no selected/source/shared-code changes).

```
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/source-bound-price-oracle --check-only
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/source-bound-price-oracle
python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/source-bound-price-oracle --check-source-history
```

Metadata/pins, registered normal and optimized runs, all 15 test groups, three frozen calibrations, 93 frozen input hashes, both policy pins, actual 28/32-artifact joins, committed-byte/source-history preflight and committed export integrity pass locally. Semantic controls reject stale or missing evidence, unknown-as-zero, authored policy enlargement, same-histogram physical receipt transfer, unsupported compiler tuples and unsupported publication/selection. Each direct run takes under one second on Python 3.12. The checked export also passes normal and optimized direct replay in a fresh temporary directory with Git absent from PATH. No scientific engine or cold/native/Lean replay was launched for packaging.

Deterministic export SHA256: `5b5d2dddf6de4f2ea06d726cb9e4e8e9187df4bbe91b6626d488825fd007ea8f` (2,037,760 bytes; 108 package files). This is transport/compatibility evidence, not hosted CI or mathematical acceptance.

## Credit

New oracle, consumer review and packaging by **Chris R / Clear1nsight**, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0. Ali Romman owns [PR #5383](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5383)'s eight-relation construction and [PR #5377](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5377); Dugongue owns successor [PR #5387](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5387). Preserve Cao Yifan's word, Cinna Davis's controller/helper lineage, zxv's native/compiler/precision work, Jacob Alan Sussman's recursion, ToikY's tensor lift, ordinary-BIT contributors and all retained original notices. Independent receipts and exact engines retain their own authorship. Generic package generator/runner credit remains Douglas Colkitt's and exporter credit remains Tekalign's.

## Open next questions

1. Which physically realizable changed word merits another reviewed policy? First freeze its exact source and independently review fresh physical, invoice, precision/stock/tape and funding receipts; matching histograms do not remove these blockers.
2. Can another compiler tuple be admitted by its source theorem? First establish literal applicability and separately fund one exact point with complete costs. Unsupported tuples and global construction optimality remain open.
